post.originalText:
Apple Vision Pro simulations are about to go next level. 

Opus 5.5 was a major unlock for building realistic simulations using native Swift RealityKit. 

Check out this workshop simulation - where I told Claude to build a 3d demonstration of incorrect saw usage. https://t.co/3DGHxnJG9Q
